evals.prompt: Orchestrate BK-210, BK-211 and BK-212 in parallel, one session per story, and report back.
evals.expected_output: Activates orca-orchestration, plans one worker per story and launches them with briefs.

evals.prompt: Set up a nightly routine that triages new bugs with nobody at the keyboard.
evals.expected_output: Activates orca-orchestration in automation mode and follows references/automations.md.

evals.prompt: Lanzá un worker por historia del sprint y supervisalos.
evals.expected_output: Activates orca-orchestration, one supervised worker per story.

evals.prompt: Preguntale al worker de BK-123 si ya terminó la ejecución.
evals.expected_output: Activates orca-orchestration and messages the worker through the orchestration runtime.

evals.prompt: My context is almost full, hand this whole session to a fresh one.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate orca-orchestration. This is a session handoff (session-handoff).

evals.prompt: Create a git worktree for my hotfix.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate orca-orchestration. Worktree setup for one's own work belongs to git-flow-master.
